INFORMATIONS.PHASE_NUMBER_TOOLTIP: Single-phase meters handle up to ~7 kVA; three-phase meters are used for higher-power installations. Affects DSO billing thresholds.
INFORMATIONS.READING_FREQUENCY_TOOLTIP: How often the DSO reads the physical meter. Monthly reading provides finer billing granularity; annual reading means interim months are estimated from consumption profiles.
INFORMATIONS.TARIF_GROUP_TOOLTIP: Voltage level at which the meter is connected to the grid. Low voltage = standard residential/commercial connection. High voltage = industrial or large-scale connection. Set by your DSO.
INFORMATIONS.WITHDRAWAL_POWER_TOOLTIP: Maximum power (in kVA) the meter is contractually allowed to draw from the grid at any instant. Found on the network contract.
INFORMATIONS.TOTAL_GENERATING_CAPACITY_TOOLTIP: Maximum power (in kVA) that the production installation connected to this meter can inject into the grid.
INFORMATIONS.AMPERAGE_TOOLTIP: Current rating of the meter's main circuit breaker in amperes. Used for tariff classification by the DSO.
INFORMATIONS.PRODUCTION_CHAIN_TOOLTIP: Type of renewable or low-carbon installation connected to this meter. Choose "None" if this is a consumption-only meter.
INFORMATIONS.INJECTION_STATUS_TOOLTIP: Describes the meter's relationship to a production installation and who holds the injection rights: owner of the installation, holder of a right-of-use, or none.
INFORMATIONS.GRD_TOOLTIP: Distribution System Operator: the regulated utility company that owns and manages the electricity grid in your area (e.g., Ores, Fluvius, Sibelga).
INFORMATIONS.RATE_TOOLTIP: Single-rate: one price 24/7. Dual-hourly: day and night prices differ. Exclusive night: all energy is billed at the night rate (typically used with large storage or heating systems).
INFORMATIONS.USAGE_TOOLTIP: Residential: private household. Professional: SME or office. Industrial: large industrial site with high-voltage connection or process loads. Determines which DSO tariff schedule applies.

DASHBOARD.BASELINE_PENDING: Before changes are tracked, confirm the starting state: what the DSO already knows of your meters and keys.
DASHBOARD.EMPTY: Nothing to do for now: no procedure in progress.

AGENDA.INTRO: Every deadline of your procedures, soonest first.
AGENDA.OPEN_HINT: Without a period: what is still owed, late ones included.
AGENDA.RANGE_HINT: Over the period: every deadline, met and cancelled ones included.

DETAIL.NOT_FOUND: This procedure does not exist, or belongs to another community.
DETAIL.EFFECT_ERROR: The CRM refused this procedure's effect: an EAN is already tracked in another operation on those dates. The procedure stays at its step.
DETAIL.FROZEN: Sent on {{date}}: the procedure is frozen. New changes go into a new draft.

CHANGES.TITLE: Changes included
CHANGES.DEFER_CONFIRM: This change leaves this procedure and joins the next one of the same type, once this one is sent or cancelled.
CHANGES.EXCLUDE_INTRO: This change will be notified to no one. The reason is kept in the log.

ERRORS.REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason for the exclusion.

PIECES.TITLE: Documents
PIECES.STALE_HINT: {{n}} piece(s) outdated by a later change.
PIECES.REGENERATE: Regenerate in one click (your corrections are kept)
PIECES.VERIFY: Check that the final regenerates identically
PIECES.TEMPLATE_SUPERSEDED: a newer version of the form is in force

SEND.TITLE: Send the procedure
SEND.INTRO: Send the message from your own mailbox (or the online form) with the documents below, then mark it as sent. The reference in the subject ties the answer back to it.
SEND.SUBJECT: Subject
SEND.FILE: The email sent (.eml) or the form's receipt (optional)
SEND.FILE_HINT: Kept as is, as proof of the sending.
SEND.BODY:
Hello,

Please find attached our request: {{procedure}} (operation: {{operation}}).
Please quote the reference {{reference}} in your answer.

Attached documents:
{{pieces}}

Kind regards,

ERRORS.DATE_REQUIRED: Give the date it was sent.

FINALS.TITLE: Pieces to attach
FINALS.READY: Every piece is final: download them and attach them to your sending.
FINALS.HINT: Generated pieces are drafts, stamped with a watermark. Generate their final versions before attaching them.

SHEET.TITLE: Entry sheet
SHEET.HINT: The values to enter in the form, in its order. Copy them one by one, or all at once.
SHEET.NOT_GENERATED: This piece is not generated yet: the sheet is empty.

SEND.MARK_SENT_HINT: Generate the final versions before marking the procedure as sent.

RESPONSE.TITLE: Add a response
RESPONSE.SUBJECT: Subject (optional)
RESPONSE.NO_MOVE: It is added to the activity, with no change of step.
RESPONSE.NOT_NOW: This response does not fit the procedure's current step.

ERRORS.TYPE_REQUIRED: Choose the type of response and its date.

TRANSITION.TITLE: Change step
TRANSITION.INTRO: For what no response records: a correction, news received by phone. The reason is kept in the log.

ERRORS.REQUIRED: Choose the step and give the reason.

CREATE.REQUESTED_EFFECT_HINT: Indicative: the real effective date follows the DSO's answer.

BASELINE.TITLE: Starting state
BASELINE.INTRO: The module has just been switched on. Tell us, for each meter and key, what the DSO already knows of it: changes are tracked from there on, and nothing earlier is replayed.
BASELINE.REACTIVATION: The module was switched on again: only the meters and keys that changed in between are listed.
BASELINE.EMPTY: No meter and no key to confirm.

HELP.ACTIVE: Active: notified to the DSO and in force.
HELP.NOT_NOTIFIED: Not notified yet: it joins a draft, to be sent.
HELP.IN_PROGRESS: In progress: already sent, the answer is awaited (give the date it was sent).
HELP.ENDED: Ended: it is no longer part of the operation.

ERRORS.SENT_DATE: Give the date it was sent for the « In progress » items: {{refs}}.
ERRORS.CONFLICT: These EANs are already tracked in another operation on those dates; nothing was confirmed: {{refs}}.

HOME.SUBTITLE: Here is where things stand today.

NEEDS_YOU.TITLE: {{count}} thing(s) need you
NEEDS_YOU.ALL_CLEAR: Nothing needs you right now. Everything is in order.
NEEDS_YOU.RECORD_ONE: {{field}} is missing from your record in “{{community}}”
NEEDS_YOU.RECORD_MANY: {{field}} and {{others}} more detail(s) are missing from your record in “{{community}}”

COMMUNITIES.TITLE: My communities
COMMUNITIES.CREATE_HINT: Leading a project? Create your community now, without waiting for an invitation: you will be its administrator.
COMMUNITIES.EMPTY: You are not part of any community yet.
COMMUNITIES.EMPTY_HINT: As soon as a community invites you, the invitation will appear here.

ENERGY.TITLE: My energy
ENERGY.HEADLINE: You used {{consumed}} kWh, of which {{shared}} kWh shared by your community.
ENERGY.INJECTED: You injected {{injected}} kWh, of which {{shared}} kWh shared with the community.
ENERGY.EMPTY: No readings for this month. They will appear here as soon as they are available.

DOCUMENTS.TITLE: My documents
DOCUMENTS.EMPTY: No document has been shared with you yet.

INVOICES.TITLE: My invoices to pay
INVOICES.EMPTY: You have no invoice awaiting payment.

FILINGS.TITLE: What has been filed about me
FILINGS.INTRO: Official documents sent to the regulator that mention you.
FILINGS.EMPTY: No official document mentions you at the moment.

CRM_DATA_SOURCE.SOURCE_LEGEND: Where does the consumption data come from?
CRM_DATA_SOURCE.SOURCE_FILE_HINT: The CSV or Excel file supplied by your grid operator.
CRM_DATA_SOURCE.SOURCE_CRM_HINT: The meter readings already held in OptimCE, for the period you choose.
CRM_DATA_SOURCE.SOURCE_CRM_SIM_HINT: The meter readings already held in OptimCE. The key's participants must match the meters' EAN codes.
CRM_DATA_SOURCE.PERIOD_HELP: Both dates are included. We use the gross readings (before sharing) of every meter in the operation.
CRM_DATA_SOURCE.PERIOD_HELP_SIM: Both dates are included. We use the gross readings (before sharing) of the meters matching the key's participants.

PREVIEW.FAILED: The data could not be checked right now. Please try again in a moment.
PREVIEW.PARTICIPANTS_MATCHED: {{count}} of the key's participants match a meter
PREVIEW.PARTICIPANTS_UNMATCHED: {{count}} of the key's participants match no meter:
PREVIEW.PARTICIPANTS_UNMATCHED_HINT: A key's participants must carry the meter's EAN code. Correct the key, or pick another sharing operation or period.
PREVIEW.INCOMPLETE_TITLE: {{count}} meter(s) have no readings for part of the period:
PREVIEW.INCOMPLETE_HINT: Missing readings will count as zero consumption. The calculation can still run, but the result will be less representative for those meters.

ADDRESS_LOOKUP.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. rue de la Station 20A, 5000 Namur
ADDRESS_LOOKUP.FOUND_EXACT: Address located: it will appear on the map.
ADDRESS_LOOKUP.FOUND_APPROXIMATE: Address located approximately, at the centre of the municipality.
ADDRESS_LOOKUP.NOT_FOUND: We could not locate this address. You can still save it as it is — it simply will not appear on the map.
ADDRESS_LOOKUP.ATTRIBUTION: Addresses: BeSt Address (CC BY 4.0) — SPW, Paradigm.Brussels, Digitaal Vlaanderen

MAP.VIEW_SWITCH_ARIA: Switch between list and map view
MAP.UNAVAILABLE_WEBGL: The map needs WebGL 2, which this browser is not providing. Hardware acceleration may be disabled, or a privacy extension may be blocking canvas access. The list view is still available.
MAP.UNAVAILABLE_LOAD: The map could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
MAP.EMPTY_TITLE: Nothing to show on the map
MAP.EMPTY_METERS: No meter matching these filters has geographic coordinates yet.
MAP.EMPTY_COMMUNITIES: No public community covers a locatable municipality.
MAP.PARTIAL_COORDINATES: {{ plotted }} of {{ total }} meters shown. {{ missing }} without coordinates and {{ approximate }} placed at the centre of their municipality.
MAP.CAPPED: Only the first {{ limit }} results are shown. Narrow your filters to see everything.

REPAIR.TITLE: Fix the missing addresses
REPAIR.SUBTITLE: {{ count }} meter(s) without coordinates. Correct the address to put them on the map.
REPAIR.EMPTY: Every meter in this view is located.

LEGEND.TITLE: Legend
LEGEND.CLUSTER: Group of markers — click to expand

HINT.REVOKED: This device has been revoked and can no longer send data. The measurements it already sent are kept.
HINT.NEVER_SEEN: This device has never connected. Check that it is powered on, and that the enrolment code was entered on the device itself.
HINT.SILENT: No data has arrived for more than a day. Check the device's power and network connection.
HINT.OFFLINE: The device reported that it was going offline, or stopped responding.
HINT.P1_NOT_ENABLED: The device is connected and sending data, but every reading is zero. The most likely cause is that the meter's P1 port has not been activated by the grid operator — this has to be requested from them and cannot be fixed on site.
HINT.INGEST_DOWN: The data collection service is currently unavailable, so nothing can be concluded about this device.

LIVE_DATA.TITLE: Live data
LIVE_DATA.SUBTITLE: Quarter-hourly telemetry from the community's smart meters.
LIVE_DATA.INDICATIVE: Indicative data. The grid operator's figures remain the only basis for allocation keys and invoicing.
LIVE_DATA.SUBSCRIPTION_LOST: Live data has been disabled for this community. An administrator can enable it again from Annex services.

SIGNAL.NEUTRAL_DETAIL: There is no consumption measurement yet, so this view cannot say whether now is a good time to use energy — only how much is being produced.

SUMMARY.NO_DATA: No measurements have been rolled up yet. A newly created community has not produced nothing — it has not been measured.

CHART.TITLE: Production and export
CHART.EMPTY: Nothing has been measured over this period.
CHART.EMPTY_WITHHELD: These meters only see the exchange with the grid, so production cannot be shown, and the export is withheld until enough members contribute.
CHART.SUPPRESSED: {{count}} period(s) had their grid figures withheld to protect members' privacy.
CHART.OFFTAKE_NOTE: Solar production used on site is not included: the meters only see the exchange with the grid.

SHARING.TITLE: Sharing within the operations (estimate)
SHARING.INJECTION_GRID: Rest of the injection to the grid
SHARING.NOTE: Estimate among {{devices}} monitored meter(s) out of {{meters}}, computed per quarter-hour within each sharing operation. The grid operator's data remains the reference.

MEMBER.TITLE: Production of my sharing operation
MEMBER.INTRO: The production of the sharing operation your meter takes part in. Where the meters only see the exchange with the grid, the energy fed into the grid is shown instead.
MEMBER.NONE: You do not currently hold an active meter in a sharing operation of this community.
MEMBER.FORBIDDEN: Your community's manager has not made these figures available to members.

ABSENT.BELOW_K_THRESHOLD: Withheld: too few members contributed to this period for the figures to be shown without identifying them.
ABSENT.NOT_MEASURED: Not measured: the meters in this community cannot see this value.
ABSENT.NO_CLOSED_HOUR_YET: The first hour of measurements has not ended yet; the figure appears once it has been computed.

DEVICES.TITLE: Devices
DEVICES.EMPTY: No device has been created for this community yet.
DEVICES.REVOKE_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: The device stops being accepted immediately and cannot be undone. The measurements it has already sent are kept.
DEVICES.COARSENED: Timestamps are hidden for a consumption device: when a household's meter was last seen is itself information about that household.
DEVICES.REJECT_CAPACITY_HINT: Production readings are being rejected as implausible: either above the device's declared capacity (kVA), or at night. Most likely the recorded capacity is lower than the inverter's, so only the sunny peaks are dropped. Check it, and the connector's clock.

CREATE.TITLE: New device
CREATE.NAME: Name
CREATE.EAN_HINT: Only the community's active meters are listed. A meter can have only one device at a time.
CREATE.EAN_EMPTY: This community has no active meter to attach a device to.
CREATE.EAN_LOAD_ERROR: The community's meters could not be loaded. Close this window and try again.
CREATE.EAN_TRUNCATED: Only the first {{shown}} of {{total}} active meters are listed.
CREATE.EAN_DEVICES_UNKNOWN: Could not check which meters already have a device. A meter that already has one will be refused when you create the device.
CREATE.PURE_INJECTION_HELP: Tick this only if the site feeds everything into the grid. On a site that also consumes, a P1 port cannot see production at all, and ticking this would understate what the community generates.

ERRORS.REQUIRED: Please provide a name and choose a meter.

TOKEN.TITLE: Enrolment code
TOKEN.SHOWN_ONCE: This code is shown once and cannot be retrieved. If it is lost, issue a new one — which invalidates this one.
TOKEN.SCAN: Scan this code with the device's setup app, or type it in by hand.

OPS.TITLE: Fleet status
OPS.SUBTITLE: What is reporting, what is not, and how fresh the figures are.
OPS.ROLLUP_STALE: The figures have not been recomputed for {{minutes}} minutes. Every device can be healthy while the collection schedule is stopped.
OPS.ROLLUP_IDLE: No data in the last 48 hours, so there is nothing to recompute.
OPS.INGEST_DOWN: Collection appears to be down: no device has reported for over a day. Check the collection service before the devices.
OPS.DEAD_LETTERS: {{count}} message(s) could not be stored in the last 24 hours.
OPS.DEAD_LETTERS_NONE: Every message received in the last 24 hours was stored.
OPS.READINGS_REJECTED: {{count}} device(s) had individual readings rejected in the last 24 hours. The Devices tab has the details.
OPS.READINGS_REJECTED_NONE: No individual reading was rejected in the last 24 hours.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Visibility
SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: What members of this community may see, and how small a group may be before figures are withheld.
SETTINGS.IS_DEFAULT: These are the platform defaults. Nothing has been saved for this community yet.
SETTINGS.MEMBERS_SEE_AGGREGATE: Members may see their sharing operation's figures
SETTINGS.MEMBERS_SEE_AGGREGATE_HELP: When off, only managers can open the dashboard.
SETTINGS.MEMBERS_SEE_PRODUCTION_HELP: When off, members are refused the dashboard entirely rather than shown it with production removed — a balance minus a consumption gives the production back exactly.
SETTINGS.K_HELP: Grid figures are withheld for any period to which fewer than this many members contributed. Production is always shown. The lowest permitted value is 3.

FORECAST.TITLE: Production forecast
FORECAST.NO_METHOD: No forecasting method is available for this community's production technology yet.

TOURS.TITLE: Guided tours
TOURS.DESCRIPTION: A tour shows you, step by step, where to click in the app. You stay in control and can stop it at any time.
TOURS.EMPTY: No guided tour is available for your role in this community.
TOURS.NO_COMMUNITY: Open a community from your home page to see its guided tours.
TOURS.LOAD_ERROR: The guided tours could not be loaded. Please try again later.
